title: 第十三章 秘卷藏玄机江湖起暗潮第十四章一诺轻生死剑影伴孤行
content_zh:
残秋，寒江孤渡。
萧琰斜倚在乌篷船头，玄色劲装衬得身形挺拔如松，腰间悬着一柄无鞘短剑“寒声”，剑刃映着江面碎光，泛着冷冽的寒意。他指尖捻着半枚残缺的青铜令牌，令牌上刻着扭曲的“玄”字，边缘被岁月磨得光滑，却依旧能窥见当年铸刻时的凌厉纹路——这是他三年前从父亲萧惊鸿的尸身旁找到的唯一信物，也是他褪去世家公子身份，沦为江湖漂泊者的开端。
三年前，萧家世居的金陵萧府一夜之间被灭门，三百二十七口人无一生还。父亲萧惊鸿身为前朝名将之后，避世多年，却始终手握一件足以搅动江湖乃至朝堂的秘宝——《玄元秘卷》。传闻此卷藏着前朝兵书谋略、绝世武学心法，更记载着一处隐秘宝藏的方位，乃是百年前玄元阁遗留的传世之物。萧惊鸿一生守着秘卷，只求安稳度日，却终究没能躲过江湖势力的觊觎，最终落得满门抄斩的下场。
彼时萧琰年仅二十，正在江南游学，侥幸躲过一劫。当他星夜赶回萧府时，昔日朱门大院已成一片焦土，断壁残垣间还残留着血迹与打斗的痕迹，父亲的尸身倒在正厅中央，胸口插着一枚刻有“影”字的毒针——那是江湖第一杀手组织“影阁”的标志。萧琰在父亲紧握的手掌中，找到了这半枚青铜令牌，还有一句模糊的遗言：“秘卷非祸，守心为上，影阁之后，另有其人。”
三年来，萧琰隐姓埋名，一边苦练父亲留下的家传剑法，一边追查萧府灭门案的真相与《玄元秘卷》的下落。他走遍大江南北，见过江湖的刀光剑影，也尝尽了人间的冷暖沧桑，昔日温润如玉的世家公子，如今已变得沉稳内敛，眼底藏着与年龄不符的沧桑与锐利，唯有在深夜抚摸那半枚青铜令牌时，才会露出一丝不易察觉的脆弱。
“客官，前面便是青石镇了，今日镇上有庙会，怕是不好泊船。”船夫的声音打断了萧琰的思绪，他抬眼望去，只见远处江边矗立着一座古朴的小镇，青石板路蜿蜒曲折，镇口挂着红灯笼，人声鼎沸，一派热闹景象。
萧琰收起青铜令牌，淡淡颔首：“便在镇口泊船，我要在此歇息一日。”他知晓青石镇是南北交通要道，鱼龙混杂，江湖人士往来频繁，或许能从这里找到关于影阁与秘卷的线索。更重要的是，他近日察觉到有人暗中跟踪自己，一路从江南追到江北，对方行踪隐秘，功力不弱，显然是冲他手中的半枚青铜令牌而来。
下船后，萧琰敛去周身的锐气，换上一身普通的青布长衫，将寒声剑藏在腰间，混在人群中走进了青石镇。庙会之上，叫卖声、欢呼声此起彼伏，杂耍艺人的表演引得众人阵阵喝彩，街边的小摊上摆满了各色小吃与饰品，一派繁华景象。但萧琰丝毫没有放松警惕，目光不动声色地扫过四周，留意着身边每一个人的动静。
行至镇中央的十字路口时，一阵清脆的打斗声突然响起，打破了庙会的宁静。只见一群身着黑衣、面带面罩的人，正围攻一位身着白衣的少女，少女手持一柄长剑，剑法灵动飘逸，却终究寡不敌众，肩头已被划了一道伤口，鲜血染红了洁白的衣衫，渐渐落入下风。
萧琰目光一凝，注意到那些黑衣人腰间都别着一枚刻有“影”字的令牌——是影阁的人。而那白衣少女手中，竟也握着半枚青铜令牌，与他手中的那半枚纹路相接，显然是一对。
“交出青铜令牌与秘卷线索，饶你不死！”为首的黑衣人声音沙哑，手中长刀挥出，带着凌厉的劲风，直逼少女要害。
少女咬紧牙关，奋力挥剑抵挡，眼中满是倔强：“影阁的恶徒，想要令牌，除非我死！”话音未落，她脚下一滑，身形不稳，黑衣人手中的长刀已然逼近她的脖颈。
就在这千钧一发之际，一道青影如闪电般掠过，萧琰身形微动，腰间寒声剑瞬间出鞘，剑刃划过一道冷冽的弧线，精准地格开了黑衣人的长刀。“铛”的一声脆响，长刀被震得脱手而出，黑衣人踉跄着后退了几步，眼中满是惊愕。
“阁下是谁？竟敢多管影阁的闲事！”为首的黑衣人怒喝一声，挥手示意其他黑衣人围攻上来。
萧琰将白衣少女护在身后，寒声剑直指黑衣人，声音冰冷：“影阁滥杀无辜，祸乱江湖，我今日便管定了。”他身形挺拔，周身散发着一股慑人的气势，虽身着青布长衫，却难掩骨子里的锋芒。
黑衣人见状，不再多言，纷纷挥刀冲向萧琰。萧琰眼神一凛，身形灵动如鬼魅，寒声剑在他手中舞出一片剑影，剑刃所过之处，劲风呼啸，黑衣人手中的长刀纷纷被斩断，惨叫声此起彼伏。他的剑法兼具刚柔，既有家传剑法的凌厉，又有三年来闯荡江湖领悟的灵动，每一剑都直指要害，却又留有余地——他要留活口，查清影阁的动向与萧府灭门案的真相。
为首的黑衣人见手下一个个倒下，心中大惊，知晓自己不是萧琰的对手，转身便想逃跑。“想走？”萧琰冷哼一声，指尖一弹，一枚银针飞出，精准地射中了黑衣人的后心。黑衣人踉跄着摔倒在地，再也无法动弹。
解决掉所有黑衣人后，萧琰收剑入鞘，转身看向身后的白衣少女。少女约莫十八九岁的年纪，眉目清秀，肌肤白皙，肩头的伤口还在流血，却依旧挺直脊背，眼神中满是感激与警惕：“多谢公子出手相救，不知公子高姓大名？为何会出手帮我？”
“萧琰。”萧琰淡淡开口，从怀中取出一个瓷瓶，递给少女，“这是金疮药，敷在伤口上，可止血止痛。至于为何帮你——”他顿了顿，取出自己手中的半枚青铜令牌，“我想，我们要找的，是同一样东西。”
白衣少女看到萧琰手中的青铜令牌，眼中满是震惊，连忙取出自己手中的那半枚，将两枚令牌拼在一起。“咔哒”一声，两枚令牌完美契合，组成一枚完整的圆形令牌，令牌中央刻着一个大大的“玄”字，周围环绕着复杂的纹路，隐隐散发着淡淡的光晕。

“你竟然也有半枚玄元令牌！”少女惊呼出声，眼中的警惕渐渐消散，多了几分亲近，“我叫苏清鸢，是玄元阁最后一任阁主的女儿。三年前，影阁的人突袭玄元阁，我父亲为了保护秘卷线索与这半枚令牌，被影阁的人杀害，我侥幸逃脱，一直在追查影阁的下落，想要夺回秘卷，为父亲报仇。”
萧琰闻言，心中一震，原来苏清鸢的遭遇与他如此相似，而玄元阁，正是《玄元秘卷》的发源地。“我乃金陵萧惊鸿之子，三年前，萧府因秘卷被影阁灭门，我父亲临终前，给了我这半枚令牌，告诉我影阁之后，另有其人。”他缓缓开口，眼底闪过一丝痛楚，“我追查了三年，始终没能找到秘卷的下落，也没能查清当年灭门案的真相，只知道影阁对秘卷势在必得。”
苏清鸢闻言，眼中满是同情，她轻轻抚摸着手中的青铜令牌，轻声说道：“萧公子，其实《玄元秘卷》并非单一的一卷，而是分为《武卷》与《谋卷》两部分。《武卷》记载着绝世武学，《谋卷》记载着前朝兵书与宝藏方位。当年我父亲将《武卷》藏在了玄元阁旧址，将《谋卷》交给了你的父亲萧惊鸿先生保管，希望两人联手，守护秘卷，不让其落入恶人之手。”
“原来如此。”萧琰恍然大悟，难怪影阁会同时突袭萧府与玄元阁，原来他们想要同时夺取两卷秘卷。“那你可知晓，影阁为何要夺取秘卷？他们背后，到底还有什么人？”
苏清鸢摇了摇头，眉头紧锁：“我不知晓影阁背后的人是谁，但我知道，影阁的阁主神秘莫测，武功极高，江湖上几乎无人见过他的真面目。而且，影阁最近动作频频，不仅在追查秘卷，还在暗中勾结江湖各大邪派，似乎在谋划一件大事。”她顿了顿，继续说道，“我近日得到消息，影阁的人会在三日后齐聚青石镇以西的幽冥谷，似乎要召开武林大会，逼迫江湖各大门派交出手中可能存在的秘卷线索。而且，我怀疑，当年突袭萧府与玄元阁的，除了影阁的人，还有其他势力的参与。”
萧琰眼神一沉，幽冥谷地势险要，机关重重，影阁选择在那里召开武林大会，显然是早有预谋。“三日后，我们便去幽冥谷，一探究竟。”他语气坚定，“我要查清当年萧府灭门案的真相，为家人报仇，也要阻止影阁夺取秘卷，祸乱江湖。”
苏清鸢点了点头，眼中闪过一丝坚定：“好，萧公子，我与你一同前往。我们两人联手，一定能查清真相，夺回秘卷，为我们的家人报仇。”
两人找了一家僻静的客栈住下，苏清鸢敷上金疮药后，伤口渐渐不再流血。萧琰坐在窗边，看着窗外的月色，指尖抚摸着寒声剑，心中思绪万千。他知道，三日后的幽冥谷，必定是一场生死较量，影阁势力庞大，还有神秘的幕后黑手，想要查清真相、夺回秘卷，难如登天。但他别无选择，为了家人，为了父亲的遗愿，也为了江湖的安宁，他必须迎难而上。
接下来的三日，萧琰与苏清鸢一边调养身体，一边商议着三日后的行动计划。苏清鸢告诉萧琰，幽冥谷内机关重重，尤其是谷口的“九曲迷阵”，一旦陷入，很难脱身，而她手中有一张玄元阁留下的幽冥谷地形图，上面标记着迷阵的破解之法。萧琰则将自己三年来闯荡江湖领悟的剑法与应变之法，告诉了苏清鸢，两人相互切磋，相互配合，渐渐有了默契。
这三日里，萧琰也察觉到，跟踪他的人依旧没有离开，只是变得更加隐秘，显然是在等待时机，想要坐收渔翁之利。萧琰心中清楚，这些人必定是冲着秘卷而来，或许是影阁的余党，或许是其他觊觎秘卷的江湖势力，但他并没有放在心上——兵来将挡，水来土掩，既然对方想要动手，他便奉陪到底。
第三日清晨，天刚蒙蒙亮，萧琰与苏清鸢便起身收拾行装，离开了客栈，向着幽冥谷的方向出发。幽冥谷位于青石镇以西百里之外，地势险要，群山环绕，谷口常年迷雾缭绕，阴风阵阵，显得格外阴森恐怖。远远望去，幽冥谷就像一头蛰伏的巨兽，等待着猎物上门。
“萧公子，前面就是幽冥谷的谷口了，我们小心行事。”苏清鸢停下脚步，从怀中取出地形图，轻声说道，“谷口的九曲迷阵，需要按照‘左三右二，前一后四’的方位行走，才能破解，千万不可走错一步，否则会陷入迷阵，再也无法脱身。”
萧琰点了点头，目光警惕地扫过四周，只见谷口迷雾缭绕，看不清里面的景象，空气中弥漫着一股淡淡的血腥味与腐朽的气息，显然已经有人先一步进入了幽冥谷。“好，我们出发，切记紧跟我的脚步，不要分开。”
两人按照地形图上的标记，小心翼翼地走进了九曲迷阵。迷阵之中，雾气更浓，能见度不足三尺，耳边传来阵阵诡异的风声，仿佛有人在暗处低语，让人不寒而栗。萧琰紧握腰间的寒声剑，目光锐利，仔细观察着周围的动静，苏清鸢则紧紧跟在萧琰身后，手中握着长剑，神色警惕。
一路上，他们遇到了不少幻象，有的是萧府灭门时的惨状，有的是苏清鸢父亲被杀害的画面，那些幻象栩栩如生，仿佛就在眼前。萧琰心中一痛，险些陷入幻象之中，但他很快回过神来，想起了父亲的遗言，想起了自己的使命，眼神变得更加坚定。他轻声提醒苏清鸢：“不要被幻象迷惑，守住本心，我们一定能走出迷阵。”
苏清鸢点了点头，深吸一口气，压下心中的痛楚，紧紧跟在萧琰身后，按照地形图的标记，一步步向着迷阵深处走去。约莫半个时辰后，两人终于走出了九曲迷阵，眼前的景象豁然开朗。
只见幽冥谷中央，有一片空旷的场地，场地中央搭建着一座高台，高台上站着一位身着黑袍、面带面罩的人，周身散发着一股慑人的寒气——想必就是影阁的阁主。高台之下，站着数百名身着黑衣的影阁弟子，还有不少江湖邪派人士，他们手持兵器，神色嚣张，眼神中满是贪婪与凶狠。场地周围，还站着一些江湖各大门派的人，他们神色凝重，显然是被影阁逼迫而来，却又不敢轻易反抗。
“萧公子，你看，那就是影阁的阁主！”苏清鸢轻声说道，眼中闪过一丝恨意，“还有那些人，都是江湖上的邪派人士，看来影阁真的暗中勾结了各大邪派。”
萧琰目光一凝，紧紧盯着高台上的黑袍人，心中暗暗思索：这个人，到底是谁？他为何要夺取秘卷？当年萧府灭门案，是不是他一手策划的？就在这时，高台上的黑袍人开口了，声音沙哑，带着一股诡异的寒意，传遍了整个幽冥谷：“今日召集各位江湖朋友前来，只为一件事——交出《玄元秘卷》的所有线索，归顺于我，我便饶你们不死。否则，今日便让你们血染幽冥谷，一个也别想活着离开！”
话音未落，台下的影阁弟子与邪派人士纷纷欢呼起来，声音嚣张，震彻山谷。而各大门派的人，神色更加凝重，相互对视一眼，却没有人敢轻易开口——影阁势力庞大，又有邪派相助，他们根本不是对手。

“好大的口气！”一道冰冷的声音突然响起，萧琰身形一动，带着苏清鸢，纵身跃到了场地中央，“影阁滥杀无辜，祸乱江湖，还想夺取秘卷，称霸武林，简直是痴心妄想！”
content_en:
In the late autumn, I cross the cold river alone.
Xiao Yan was leaning on the bow of the black awning boat. His black outfit made him as tall as a pine. An unsheathed dagger "Hansheng" hung on his waist. The blade reflected the broken light on the river, giving off a cold chill. He was twisting a half-broken bronze token between his fingertips. The token was engraved with a twisted Chinese character "Xuan", and its edges had been worn smooth by the years, but the sharp lines from when it was cast could still be seen - this was the only token he found next to the body of his father, Xiao Jinghong, three years ago. It was also the beginning of him losing his status as a son of a family and becoming a wanderer in the world.
Three years ago, the Xiao Mansion in Jinling, where the Xiao family lived for a long time, was wiped out overnight, and no one of the 327 members of the family survived. After his father Xiao Jinghong became a famous general in the former dynasty, he had secluded himself from the world for many years, but he still held a secret treasure that could stir up the world and even the court - the "Xuanyuan Secret Scroll". It is rumored that this volume contains the military strategies and strategies of the previous dynasties, as well as peerless martial arts techniques. It also records the location of a hidden treasure, which was handed down from Xuanyuan Pavilion a hundred years ago. Xiao Jinghong kept the secret scroll all his life, just to live a stable life, but in the end he was unable to escape the covetousness of the Jianghu forces, and eventually ended up having his entire family beheaded.
At that time, Xiao Yan was only 20 years old and was studying in the south of the Yangtze River. He was lucky enough to escape. When he rushed back to Xiao Mansion at starry night, the former Zhumen Courtyard was in scorched earth, with traces of blood and fighting still remaining among the broken walls. His father's body lay in the center of the main hall, with a poisonous needle engraved with the word "shadow" inserted in his chest - it was the symbol of the "Shadow Pavilion", the number one killer organization in the world. Xiao Yan found the half bronze token in his father's clenched palm, as well as a vague last word: "The secret scroll is not a disaster. Keep your heart first. There is someone else behind the Shadow Pavilion."
For three years, Xiao Yan remained anonymous, practicing the family swordsmanship passed down by his father while tracing the truth behind the murder of the Xiao family and the whereabouts of the "Xuanyuan Secret Scroll". He has traveled all over the country, seen the swords and shadows of the rivers and lakes, and tasted the vicissitudes of life. The former gentle and jade-like young master of an aristocratic family has now become calm and reserved, with vicissitudes and sharpness that belie his age hidden in his eyes. Only when he touches the half of the bronze token late at night will he reveal a trace of vulnerability that is not easy to detect.
"Sir, Qingshi Town is ahead. There is a temple fair in the town today, so it's difficult to berth the boat." The boatman's voice interrupted Xiao Yan's thoughts. He looked up and saw a quaint small town standing by the river in the distance. The bluestone road was winding, red lanterns were hung at the entrance of the town, and there was a lot of people and a lively scene.
Xiao Yan put away the bronze token and nodded lightly: "I will anchor the boat at the entrance of the town. I want to rest here for a day." He knew that Qingshi Town was an important transportation route between the north and the south, with a mixture of fish and dragons, and frequent exchanges between people from all walks of life. Maybe he could find clues about the Shadow Pavilion and the secret scroll here. More importantly, he recently noticed that someone was secretly following him, chasing him all the way from Jiangnan to Jiangbei. The person's whereabouts were secretive and his skills were not weak. He was obviously coming for the half bronze token in his hand.
After getting off the boat, Xiao Yan suppressed his energy, put on an ordinary green cloth gown, hid the Hansheng Sword at his waist, and walked into Qingshi Town among the crowd. At the temple fair, cries and cheers arose one after another. The performances of jugglers attracted cheers from the crowd. The street stalls were filled with all kinds of snacks and accessories, creating a bustling scene. But Xiao Yan did not relax his vigilance at all, and swept his eyes quietly around, paying attention to the movements of everyone around him.
When they reached the crossroads in the center of the town, a crisp sound of fighting suddenly sounded, breaking the tranquility of the temple fair. I saw a group of people in black clothes and masks, besieging a girl in white clothes. The girl was holding a long sword. Her sword skills were agile and elegant, but she was ultimately outnumbered. There was a wound on her shoulder, and the blood dyed her white clothes red, and she gradually fell into the disadvantage.
Xiao Yan focused his eyes and noticed that the men in black wore tokens with the word "shadow" engraved on their waists - they were from the Shadow Pavilion. And in the hands of the girl in white, actually holding half a bronze token, which was connected with the half token in his hand, obviously a pair.
"Hand over the bronze token and the clues to the secret scroll, and I will spare your life!" The leader of the man in black had a hoarse voice, and swung the long knife in his hand, with a strong wind, and it hit the girl's vitals.
The girl gritted her teeth and waved her sword to resist, her eyes full of stubbornness: "The villains of Shadow Pavilion want the token, unless I die!" Before she could finish her words, her foot slipped, her body became unstable, and the long knife in the hand of the man in black was already close to her neck.
At this critical moment, a green shadow passed by like lightning. Xiao Yan's body moved slightly, and the Hansheng Sword at his waist was instantly unsheathed. The blade drew a cold arc and accurately blocked the long knife of the man in black. There was a crisp sound of "clang", and the long knife was shaken out of his hand. The man in black staggered back a few steps, his eyes full of shock.
"Who is your Excellency? How dare you meddle in Shadow Pavilion's business!" The leader of the men in black shouted angrily, waving his hand to signal the other men in black to attack.
Xiao Yan protected the girl in white behind him, pointed the Hansheng Sword directly at the man in black, and said in a cold voice: "The Shadow Pavilion kills innocent people indiscriminately and causes trouble in the world. I will take care of it today." He has a tall and tall body, exuding an intimidating aura. Although he is wearing a long green cloth gown, he can't hide the sharp edge in his bones.
Seeing this, the men in black stopped saying anything and rushed towards Xiao Yan with their swords. Xiao Yan's eyes flashed, and his figure was as agile as a ghost. The Hansheng Sword danced in his hand, and strong winds roared wherever the blade passed. The long knives in the hands of the men in black were cut off one after another, and screams occurred one after another. His swordsmanship is both strong and soft, with the sharpness of the swordsmanship passed down from his family, and the agility gained from his three years of wandering around the world. Every sword is aimed directly at the vital point, but leaves some room for it - he wants to stay alive to find out the truth about the movements of the Shadow Pavilion and the murder case of Xiao Mansion.
The leading man in black was shocked when he saw his men fall one by one. Knowing that he was no match for Xiao Yan, he turned around and wanted to escape. "Want to leave?" Xiao Yan snorted coldly, flicked his fingertips, and a silver needle flew out, accurately hitting the man in black in the back of the heart. The man in black staggered and fell to the ground, unable to move anymore.
After taking care of all the men in black, Xiao Yan sheathed his sword and turned to look at the girl in white behind him. The girl is about eighteen or nineteen years old, with delicate features and fair skin. The wound on her shoulder is still bleeding, but her back is still straight. Her eyes are full of gratitude and vigilance: "Thank you for saving me, sir. I wonder what your name is? Why did you help me?"
"Xiao Yan." Xiao Yan said calmly, took out a porcelain bottle from his arms and handed it to the girl, "This is golden sore medicine. Apply it to the wound to stop bleeding and relieve pain. As for why I am helping you -" He paused and took out half of the bronze token in his hand, "I think we are looking for the same thing."
When the girl in white saw the bronze token in Xiao Yan's hand, her eyes were full of shock. She quickly took out the half of the token in her hand and put the two tokens together. With a "click", the two tokens fit perfectly to form a complete circular token. A large "Xuan" character was engraved in the center of the token, surrounded by complex lines and faintly exuding a faint halo.
"You actually have half a Xuanyuan Token!" The girl exclaimed, the vigilance in her eyes gradually dissipated, and she became a little more intimate. "My name is Su Qingyuan, and I am the daughter of the last master of Xuanyuan Pavilion. Three years ago, people from the Shadow Pavilion raided the Xuanyuan Pavilion. My father was killed by the people from the Shadow Pavilion in order to protect the secret scroll clues and the half token. I escaped by chance and have been tracking down the whereabouts of the Shadow Pavilion. I want to take back the secret scroll and avenge my father."
When Xiao Yan heard this, he was shocked. It turned out that Su Qingyuan's experience was so similar to his, and Xuanyuan Pavilion was the birthplace of "Xuanyuan Secret Scroll". "I am the son of Xiao Jinghong in Jinling. Three years ago, the Xiao family was destroyed by the Shadow Pavilion because of the secret scroll. Before my father died, he gave me this half token and told me that there was someone else behind the Shadow Pavilion." He spoke slowly, with a trace of pain flashing in his eyes.Chu, "I have been pursuing it for three years, but I have never been able to find the whereabouts of the secret scroll, nor have I been able to find out the truth about the family extermination case. I only know that the Shadow Pavilion is bound to get the secret scroll."
When Su Qingyuan heard this, her eyes were full of sympathy. She gently touched the bronze token in her hand and said softly: "Mr. Xiao, in fact, the Xuanyuan Secret Scroll is not a single volume, but is divided into two parts, the Martial Scroll and the Conspiracy Scroll. The Martial Scroll records peerless martial arts. "The Secret Scroll" records the military books of the previous dynasty and the location of the treasure. My father hid the "Martial Scroll" at the old site of Xuanyuan Pavilion and gave the "Mou Scroll" to your father, Mr. Xiao Jinghong, for safekeeping. He hoped that the two of them would work together to protect the secret scroll and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands. "
"So that's it." Xiao Yan suddenly realized that it was no wonder that Shadow Pavilion would raid Xiao Mansion and Xuanyuan Pavilion at the same time. It turned out that they wanted to seize two secret volumes at the same time. "Then do you know why Shadow Pavilion wants to seize the secret scroll? Who else is behind them?"
Su Qingyuan shook her head and frowned: "I don't know who is behind the Shadow Pavilion, but I know that the master of the Shadow Pavilion is mysterious and has extremely high martial arts skills. Almost no one in the world has seen his true face. Moreover, the Shadow Pavilion has been active recently. It is not only tracing the secret scroll, but also secretly colluding with the major evil sects in the world. It seems to be planning a big thing." She After a pause, he continued, "I recently received news that people from the Shadow Pavilion will gather in the Netherworld Valley to the west of Qingshi Town in three days. It seems that they are going to hold a martial arts conference to force the various sects in the world to hand over clues to the secret scrolls that may exist in their hands. Moreover, I suspect that in addition to the people from the Shadow Pavilion, other forces were involved in the raids on Xiao Mansion and Xuanyuan Pavilion."
Xiao Yan's eyes darkened. The Netherworld Valley had a dangerous terrain and many institutions. The Shadow Pavilion chose to hold the martial arts conference there, which was obviously a premeditated plan. "In three days, we will go to Netherworld Valley to find out what's going on." He said firmly, "I want to find out the truth about the murder of Xiao Mansion, avenge my family, and also prevent Shadow Pavilion from seizing the secret scroll and causing trouble in the world."
Su Qingyuan nodded, a trace of determination flashed in his eyes: "Okay, Mr. Xiao, I will go with you. Together, the two of us will be able to find out the truth, regain the secret scroll, and avenge our family."
The two found a secluded inn to stay. After Su Qingyuan applied the golden sore medicine, the wound gradually stopped bleeding. Xiao Yan sat by the window, looking at the moonlight outside the window, stroking the Hansheng Sword with his fingertips, and had a lot of thoughts in his heart. He knew that in the Netherworld Valley three days later, there would be a life and death battle. The Shadow Pavilion was hugely powerful and there was a mysterious mastermind behind it. Finding out the truth and regaining the secret scroll would be as difficult as climbing to the sky. But he has no choice. For the sake of his family, his father's last wish, and the peace of the world, he must face the difficulties.
In the next three days, Xiao Yan and Su Qingyuan recuperated their bodies while discussing their action plan for the next three days. Su Qingyuan told Xiao Yan that there were many mechanisms in the Netherworld Valley, especially the "Nine-Turn Maze" at the entrance of the valley. Once trapped, it would be difficult to escape. In her hand, she had a topographic map of the Netherworld Valley left by Xuanyuan Pavilion, which marked the method of cracking the maze. Xiao Yan told Su Qingyuan the swordsmanship and adaptability methods he had learned during his three years of wandering around the world. The two learned from each other, cooperated with each other, and gradually developed a tacit understanding.
In the past three days, Xiao Yan also noticed that the person following him still did not leave, but became more secretive. Apparently he was waiting for the opportunity and wanted to reap the benefits. Xiao Yan knew in his heart that these people must be coming for the secret scroll. They might be the remnants of the Shadow Pavilion, or they might be other forces in the world that covet the secret scroll, but he didn't take it to heart - soldiers will stop them, and water will cover them. Since the other party wants to take action, he will accompany them to the end.
On the early morning of the third day, when it was just dawn, Xiao Yan and Su Qingyuan got up, packed their bags, left the inn, and set off in the direction of Netherworld Valley. Netherworld Valley is located a hundred miles west of Qingshi Town. The terrain is dangerous, surrounded by mountains, and the entrance of the valley is shrouded in fog all year round.Surrounded by dark winds, it looked particularly eerie and terrifying. From a distance, Netherworld Valley looks like a dormant giant beast, waiting for its prey to come.
"Mr. Xiao, the entrance to the Netherworld Valley is ahead. Let's proceed with caution." Su Qingyuan stopped, took out the terrain map from her arms, and said softly, "The nine-curve maze at the entrance of the valley needs to be walked in the direction of 'three left, two right, four forward, one back' to break it. You must not make a wrong step, otherwise you will fall into the maze and never be able to escape."
Xiao Yan nodded and scanned the surroundings with vigilance. He saw that the entrance of the valley was shrouded in mist, making it difficult to see the scene inside. There was a faint smell of blood and decay in the air. It was obvious that someone had entered the Netherworld Valley first. "Okay, let's set off. Remember to follow me closely and don't separate."
The two of them followed the marks on the terrain map and carefully walked into the maze of nine curves. In the maze, the fog became thicker and the visibility was less than three feet. There were strange wind sounds in the ears, as if someone was whispering in the dark, which made people shudder. Xiao Yan held the Hansheng Sword tightly at his waist, his eyes sharp, and he carefully observed the movements around him. Su Qingyuan followed Xiao Yan closely, holding a long sword in his hand and looking alert.
Along the way, they encountered many illusions, some of which were the tragic scene when the Xiao family was wiped out, and some of which were scenes of Su Qingyuan's father being killed. Those illusions were so lifelike that they seemed to be right in front of their eyes. Xiao Yan felt a pain in his heart and almost fell into an illusion, but he quickly came back to his senses and remembered his father's last words and his mission, and his eyes became firmer. He reminded Su Qingyuan softly: "Don't be fooled by illusions, keep your heart, and we will definitely get out of the maze."
Su Qingyuan nodded, took a deep breath, suppressed the pain in her heart, followed Xiao Yan closely, and followed the marks on the terrain map, walking step by step deeper into the fascination array. About half an hour later, the two finally walked out of the maze of nine curves, and the scene in front of them suddenly became clear.
I saw an empty field in the center of the Netherworld Valley. In the center of the field was a high platform. Standing on the high platform was a man wearing a black robe and a mask, exuding a frightening cold air - he must be the master of the Shadow Pavilion. Under the high platform, stood hundreds of Shadow Pavilion disciples dressed in black, as well as many evil sect members. They were holding weapons, looking arrogant, and their eyes were full of greed and ferocity. Around the venue, there were still some people from various sects in the world, with solemn expressions. They were obviously forced to come here by the Shadow Pavilion, but they did not dare to resist easily.
"Young Master Xiao, look, that is the Pavilion Master of the Shadow Pavilion!" Su Qingyuan said softly, with a trace of hatred flashing in her eyes, "And those people are all evil sects in the world. It seems that the Shadow Pavilion has really secretly colluded with the major evil sects."
Xiao Yan's eyes narrowed, staring closely at the man in black robe on the high platform, thinking secretly in his heart: Who is this person? Why did he want to seize the secret scroll? Was he the one who planned the murder of the Xiao family back then? At this moment, the man in black robes on the high platform spoke, his voice hoarse, with a strange chill that spread throughout the Netherworld Valley: "Today, I have summoned all my friends from all walks of life to come here for one thing only - to hand over all the clues to the "Xuanyuan Secret Scroll" and submit to me, and I will spare your life. Otherwise, you will be stained with blood in the Netherworld Valley today, and no one will be able to leave alive!"
Before he finished speaking, the Shadow Pavilion disciples and evil sect members in the audience cheered one after another, their voices so arrogant that they shook the valley. The people from the various sects looked at each other more solemnly and looked at each other, but no one dared to speak easily - the Shadow Pavilion was hugely powerful and had evil sects to help them, so they were no match at all.
"What a loud tone!" A cold voice suddenly sounded. Xiao Yan moved and jumped to the center of the field with Su Qingyuan. "The Shadow Pavilion kills innocent people indiscriminately, brings chaos to the world, and wants to seize the secret scroll and dominate the martial arts. It is simply a wishful thinking!"
